notes.title: Speakeasy Update
notes.content:
We're always working to improve your gaming experience! 🚀 This update includes:

Faster Game Launch: Get into the action quicker than ever.
General Fixes: Enhanced performance and resolved minor issues.
Enjoy defending your speakeasy with even smoother gameplay! 🎮

notes.title: 🎉 20,000 Downloads Celebration & Steam Achievements! 🎉
notes.content:
[u][b]Dear Speakeasy Community,[/b][/u]

We are beyond excited to announce that Speakeasy has reached an incredible milestone — 20,000 downloads! This amazing achievement would not have been possible without your unwavering support and enthusiasm for the game.

To mark this special occasion, we're thrilled to finally deliver a feature many of you have been eagerly awaiting: [b]Steam Achievements[/b]! Now, as you navigate through the thrilling world of Speakeasy, you'll have the chance to unlock a variety of achievements that will challenge and reward you for your gameplay skills.

Thank you once again for being a part of this journey with us. We can't wait to see how many of you will earn these new achievements. 

Best Regards, 

Team 3 Studios

notes.title: 📰 Informational Announcement 📰
notes.content:
Dear Speakeasy Community,

We have an update to share with you! 

🏆[b]Achievements for Speakeasy[/b]: now visible on the Steam store page. However, please [u]note that they are currently in a testing phase and are not yet functional within the game[/u].

Rest assured, we are working to integrate these achievements into the game experience. We will make a formal announcement as soon as they are fully operational.

In the meantime, feel free to [b]take a sneak peek[/b] at the achievements to [b]prepare for the challenges ahead![/b]

We appreciate your patience and support as we work to bring you the best possible gaming experience. Stay tuned for further updates, and thank you for being part of the Speakeasy community!


Best regards,

[b]Team 3 Studios[/b]

notes.title: 🎉1st Update Announcement! 🎉
notes.content:
[u][b]Dear Speakeasy Community,[/b][/u]

We're thrilled to share some exciting news with you all! First and foremost, we want to extend our heartfelt gratitude for your incredible support. Thanks to you, Speakeasy has reached an incredible milestone of 12,000 downloads since its release. Your enthusiasm and feedback have been invaluable to us.

Now, onto the big news: we're rolling out our first major update! This update brings several enhancements to the game, including:

📚 [b]Game Tutorial:[/b] We've heard your feedback and are excited to introduce a comprehensive game tutorial to help newcomers dive into the action-packed world of Speakeasy with ease.

🛠️ [b]Minor Fixes and Improvements:[/b] We've polished up the game with new icons, tweaks to the in-game UI, and various optimizations to enhance your gaming experience.

We are also thrilled to announce that a [b]new game mode is now in development[/b]. Stay tuned for more details on this exciting addition in the near future.

As several of you have expressed interest in Steam Achievements, we are pleased to announce that we are currently developing an integration for them in the next game update.

Thank you once again for your incredible support and enthusiasm. We can't wait to continue this journey with you all!

Best regards,

Team 3 Studios
